title: Venezuelan Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Venezuela, made with tender beef and a rich mixture of spices.

ingredients.name: Brown beef, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the browned beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the Venezuelan stew, beef broth, and water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Return the beef to the pot and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
